assign.outcome:
**Every card now gets its own assistant and its own manager, and a master assistant and mastermind-servex watch across all cards. Proven 12 of 12 on a private Servex, merged into michael/dev (d447febd), live at the next Servex restart.**

![The design](/framework/ai/2026-09-24/assistant-layers/shots/design-1920.png)

- **Speak on a card**: that card's own assistant (`assistant-<card>`) answers within seconds and turns your words into sub-cards and replies. When something needs doing, it hands it to that card's manager (`manager-<card>`), whose session is kept for the card's whole life.
- **Speak with no card**: the lobby files your words into the right AI 2 group (System design, Servex, …), and that group's own assistant answers there.
- **Across cards**: `master-assistant` hears every card and points out clashes (it flagged "header blue" vs "header red"). `mastermind-servex` is the architect: it keeps the claims list and launches nothing.
- **Nothing starts twice**: a manager claims the thing it will change ("the site header"); a second card's claim on it is refused and goes to mastermind-servex.
- **Who is talking is real**: Servex stamps every message with the sender's id from its connection, and a table says who may message whom. Refusals are logged at `/api/policy`.
- **Memory**: idle agents stop and resume by session id; a reaper stops finished helpers; nothing new starts under 4 GB free or past 30 agents.
- **Each card shows its agents**: tokens and % of window, with Compact and Recycle (hidden until the restart).

**Pages:** [design page](/framework/ai/2026-09-24/assistant-layers/) · [the design in detail](/framework/ai/2026-09-24/assistant-layers/md/doc/design/) · how the code works: `Servex/agents/doc/layers.md` in the repo · [proof, 12 of 12](/framework/ai/2026-09-24/assistant-layers/proof.json)

**Left:** the restart itself, handed to mastermind-servex to time (it cuts every agent's current turn). The Layers/Global workaround for held messages can go once servex-monitor's 592d5614 is live. The shared day page.js children line is uncommitted until servex-mastermind and inventory commit their folders.
